en: A vintage black and white postcard featuring an aerial view over a European town with a prominent church tower on the right. The rooftops of the old buildings and a straight street populated by some pedestrians are visible. In the distance, a river or large body of water and tree-lined banks can be seen. The postcard bears the names 'Zemun', 'Semlin' in both Cyrillic and Latin scripts at the top.
